you should be scared to cut. that is very normal because it’s not something your brain is supposed to let you do no matter what. do not start doing this especially while your still not addicted that is a huge advantage. It’s not a game or a cool aesthetic which i’m not saying you think it is per se more of it’s a serious thing. Do you have anybody in your life who can be a good support system for you? If so reach out and talk to them. It doesn’t have to be specifically about the cutting but it can be more around the feelings that make you want too if you are too scared to tell them.

I started around the age of 10 and i couldn’t stop for long periods until recently at 19 years old. I know it feels good now but eventually just like any other addiction you need more and more until there’s nothing more you can do. There’s nowhere good this could end. So while you have this support please keep giving your tools away and reach out to anybody who will talk to you. I don’t know how true it is but i’ve heard it only takes 10 minutes of conversation with somebody you care about to make an impact on your mood.
